page_title: Elevator Saga The elevator programming game

summary.title: Elevator Saga - The elevator programming game
summary.one_liner: Learn to control elevators by writing JavaScript event handlers that decide where each elevator goes to move passengers efficiently.
takeaways: Elevators are controlled by a JavaScript init function that registers event handlers such as 'idle'.
The elevator.goToFloor(n) call sends an elevator to a given floor.
The update(dt, elevators, floors) function runs every tick and is usually unnecessary for simple solutions.
The goal is to transport as many passengers as possible while minimizing waiting and elapsed time.
summary.summary: Elevator Saga is a browser-based programming game where you write JavaScript to control elevators in a building. The page shows a sample solution that sets an init function, listens for the elevator's idle event, and sends the elevator to floors with goToFloor. The interface tracks transported passengers, elapsed time, average and max waiting time, and number of moves as performance metrics. The page text is mostly the game UI and sample code, so the details beyond these are not described.
